gaps.lead: People claim that this juice cures colds.
She got up early so that she wouldn't miss the train.
gaps.sentence: She got up early ___ the train.
gaps.explanation: so as not to / in order not to + infinitive express negative purpose.

gaps.lead: It was a mistake to sell the boat.
gaps.explanation: should/shouldn't have + past participle criticises a past action.

gaps.lead: It's forbidden to use mobile phones in the exam.
gaps.explanation: mustn't + be + participle: mustn't be used.

gaps.lead: I haven't seen such a good film for ages.
gaps.sentence: It was ___ I had seen for ages.
gaps.explanation: Not…such a good film for ages = the best film (I had seen) for ages.

gaps.lead: You must sign the form in ink.
gaps.explanation: sign the form in ink → the form must be signed in ink.
